name: Broccoli Sulforaphane Power Bowl
ingredients: broccoli (raw or lightly steamed); quinoa; avocado; sunflower seeds; lemon juice; garlic; olive oil; turmeric; black pepper
target_nutrients: sulforaphane; curcumin; ascorbic acid; quercetin; lutein
preparation: Lightly steam broccoli (maximizes sulforaphane). Cook quinoa. Toss with avocado, seeds, lemon-garlic-turmeric dressing.

name: Spiced Chickpea and Spinach Curry
ingredients: chickpeas; spinach; tomato; onion; garlic; ginger; turmeric; cumin; coriander; cinnamon; coconut milk
target_nutrients: curcumin; gingerol; allicin; quercetin; lutein; ascorbic acid
preparation: Sauté onion, garlic, ginger with spices. Add tomatoes, chickpeas, coconut milk. Simmer 15 min. Add spinach at end.

name: Kale Caesar with Capers and Nutritional Yeast
ingredients: kale (massaged); capers; nutritional yeast; garlic; lemon juice; olive oil; hemp seed; mustard; black pepper
target_nutrients: quercetin; luteolin; ascorbic acid; lutein; allicin
preparation: Massage kale with olive oil and lemon. Add capers, nutritional yeast, hemp seeds. Toss with garlic-mustard dressing.

name: Golden Turmeric Lentil Soup
ingredients: red lentils; turmeric; ginger; garlic; onion; coconut milk; spinach; lemon juice; cumin; coriander
target_nutrients: curcumin; gingerol; allicin; ascorbic acid; quercetin
preparation: Sauté onion, garlic, ginger. Add turmeric, cumin, coriander. Add lentils and water, cook 20 min. Stir in spinach and coconut milk.

name: Mediterranean Quinoa with Herbs
ingredients: quinoa; parsley; oregano; thyme; tomato; cucumber; olive oil; lemon juice; olive; red onion; mint
preparation: Cook quinoa. Chop herbs and vegetables. Toss with olive oil-lemon dressing.

name: Roasted Root Vegetables with Rosemary
ingredients: sweet potato; carrot; beet; onion; garlic; rosemary; thyme; olive oil; black pepper; balsamic vinegar
preparation: Cube vegetables. Toss with olive oil, herbs, garlic. Roast at 200°C for 35 min. Drizzle with balsamic.

name: Cruciferous Crunch Salad with Tahini
ingredients: broccoli (raw, grated); brussels sprouts (shaved); cabbage; carrot; tahini; lemon juice; garlic; apple cider vinegar; pomegranate seeds; walnut
preparation: Grate broccoli and brussels sprouts. Shave cabbage. Toss with tahini-lemon-garlic dressing. Top with pomegranate and walnuts.

name: Green Tea Berry Antioxidant Smoothie
ingredients: green tea (brewed, chilled); blueberry; strawberry; banana; flax seed; spinach; lemon juice
target_nutrients: epigallocatechin gallate; ascorbic acid; quercetin; lutein
preparation: Brew green tea, chill. Blend with berries, banana, spinach, flax, lemon.

name: Ginger-Green Tea Recovery Broth
ingredients: ginger (fresh); green tea; lemon; turmeric; black pepper; honey substitute (agave); seaweed (nori)
target_nutrients: gingerol; epigallocatechin gallate; curcumin; ascorbic acid
preparation: Brew ginger and green tea. Add turmeric, black pepper, lemon, agave. Float nori strips.

name: Overnight Oats with Berries and Flax
ingredients: rolled oats; flax seed; chia seed; blueberry; strawberry; walnut; cinnamon; vanilla; soy milk
preparation: Combine oats, seeds, soy milk, cinnamon, vanilla. Refrigerate overnight. Top with berries and walnuts in the morning.

name: Spicy Peanut Soba Noodles
ingredients: buckwheat soba noodles; peanut butter; ginger; garlic; soy sauce; rice vinegar; chili; cabbage; carrot; scallion
preparation: Cook soba noodles. Whisk peanut sauce with ginger, garlic, soy, vinegar. Toss with shredded cabbage and carrot.

name: Cocoa-Chia Pudding with Raspberries
ingredients: chia seed; cocoa; raspberry; almond milk; vanilla; maple syrup; walnut
preparation: Mix chia, cocoa, almond milk, vanilla, maple syrup. Refrigerate 4+ hours. Top with raspberries and walnuts.
